title: 第53章 惊天雷暴

第53章 惊天雷暴-《我发现了世界BUG》

唐风望着天上眉头紧皱，他实在想不出到底有什么办法可以救出林飘雪和美英。

白子阳痛苦扭曲的脸，渐渐恢复了平缓，眼睛也缓缓闭了起来，脸色惨白的滑进了桶内。

绮罗连忙开口：“什么下人呢，都是大少奶奶和芸娘一起做的，我们还插不上手呢！”说得曹良瑟一番尴尬，忙怪绮罗多嘴。

“你什么时候把这张皮裹怀里去的！”蓝麟风咬着后槽牙，紧绷着脸道。

“你的生存又葬送了多少生命？”我拨开脚边一只僵硬的山鼠道。

“谁？谁在那？”应北晨警惕的掏出手枪，对准我的方向，不断游移，却始终无法瞄准。

王县长晃一晃自己的手，手腕上带的是一百多块的国产手表，网上买的话更便宜几十块都能买到，将自己充话费688元送的华为手机往桌子上一放。

唐风心里一颤，他实在不想和这条搏杀能力超强的畜生搏斗拼命，网纹蟒，这种和亚马逊森蚺齐名的蟒蛇，它的战斗记录里有杀死过凯门鳄、野猪、甚至美洲虎等战斗力相当强的猛兽，不过事到如今已经是箭在弦上了。

叶窈窕轻轻叹了口气，然后才抬起手，从衣柜里挑了一件玫红的外套，放在身上比划了一下，觉得太靓了，到时候韩夫人又会说自己是狐狸精。

他的目光中全是阴毒，宛若毒蛇一般，身上的气势更是无比的惊人。

异族联军中几乎人人都知道洛天的大名，见过洛天画像的却很少，而见过洛天本人的更是凤毛麟角，此刻只是认为洛天很不凡，却并不知道眼前这个年轻男人就是大名鼎鼎的传奇天才。

宁志国已经为他受伤，他不想胡玉怡再为他受伤，那样的话，他会非常愧疚。

“你还有力气一战？”狠人仰头大笑，双手背后，哪怕是他的双腿此刻还在发抖，依旧耀眼的让人无法直视，这个时候的他，还是那个屠龙的狠人。

Tang Feng looked at the sky and frowned. He really couldn't think of any way to rescue Lin Piaoxue and Meiying.

Bai Ziyang's painfully twisted face gradually regained its composure, his eyes slowly closed, and he slid into the bucket with a pale face.

Qiluo hurriedly said: "Who are you? The eldest mistress and Yun Niang are doing it together. We can't get involved yet!" This made Cao Liangse feel awkward and blamed Qiluo for talking too much.

"When did you wrap this piece of skin in your arms?" Lan Linfeng said with a tight face, biting his back molars.

"How many lives have you ruined by your survival?" I asked as I pushed away a stiff mountain rat at my feet.

"Who? Who's there?" Ying Beichen took out his pistol vigilantly and pointed it in my direction. He kept moving but could not aim.

County Magistrate Wang shook his hand. He was wearing a domestic watch worth more than 100 yuan on his wrist. You can buy it online for dozens of yuan cheaper. He put the Huawei mobile phone he gave away with 688 yuan of phone credit on the table.

Tang Feng's heart trembled. He really didn't want to fight this beast with super strong fighting ability. The reticulated python, a python as famous as the Amazon anaconda, has killed caiman, wild boar, even jaguar and other powerful beasts in its combat records, but now it is ready.

Ye Yaoyao sighed softly, then raised her hand, picked out a rose red coat from the closet, put it on her body and felt it was too beautiful. Then Mrs. Han would say that she was a vixen again.

His eyes were full of venom, like a poisonous snake, and the aura on his body was even more astonishing.

Almost everyone in the alien coalition knows Luo Tian's name, but very few have seen Luo Tian's portrait, and even fewer have seen Luo Tian himself. At this moment, they just think Luo Tian is extraordinary, but they don't know that the young man in front of them is a famous legendary genius.

Ning Zhiguo was already hurt by him, and he didn't want Hu Yuyi to be hurt by him again. In that case, he would feel very guilty.

"Do you still have the strength to fight?" The ruthless man threw his head back and laughed, with his hands behind his back, even though his legs were still shaking at this moment, it was still so dazzling that people couldn't look directly at him. At this time, he was still the ruthless man who slayed the dragon.
